$comment: The sigil-bergamot helper: Mozilla's Bergamot translation engine (the inference/ tree of mozilla/translations, i.e. bergamot-translator with Mozilla's marian fork, intgemm int8) behind a JSON-lines stdio protocol, run by process_host (recipes::bergamot, StdioMode::Protocol) and driven by mt_local/bergamot.rs. Owned by P4-E; decision record docs/adr/0008-bergamot.md. Upstream pin: scripts/runtime-packs/bergamot/helper/UPSTREAM.json.

Built locally by scripts/runtime-packs/bergamot/build.ps1 (MSVC, static CRT, AVX2 by default) and kept 'unpublished' (asset hosting is local only): install it by local import in Models & Runtimes, or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS (the zip is found by file name). Unpinned while unpublished; pin size and sha256 from the build's .zip.sha256 when publishing.

The zip holds sigil-bergamot.exe, sigil-pack.json (arch, protocol, sha256 of every file; mt_local/bergamot.rs checks arch and protocol before starting it) and the license texts. The models are the mt-bergamot/* entries (mt-bergamot.json), which require this pack.
Upgrade: bump UPSTREAM.json (and its shim_revision), then this entry's version and zip name together.

entries.title: Firefox Translations engine (Bergamot)
entries.description: Mozilla's offline translation engine from Firefox, run by Sigil as a small helper process on the processor (no graphics memory; needs AVX2). Translates caption lines in tens of milliseconds with the Firefox Translations models.
